title: Software Dev Engineer, Game-Based Learning
description:
Software Dev Engineer, Game-Based Learning

AWS Game-Based Learning Products is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join a fast-paced, startup-minded innovation team where fun is an integral part of your job. Joining our team, you will collaborate with a team of architects, artists, designers, engineers, and testers responsible for the conception, development and operations of highly technical game-based learning solutions that rely on extensive use of hands-on labs, virtual environments, and interactive simulations to get customers to develop practical skills using AWS services.
As a Software Development Engineer, you will partner with fellow backend engineers to build cloud services platforms that are foundational to our games; you will collaborate with Unity3d engineers to create rich gameplays; you will cooperate with designers and artists to develop a compelling end-to-end visual gaming experience; and you will assist learning architects and instructional designers map learning objectives and game elements to deliver a unique cloud learning experience to our players.
For more information about some of our products:
- job responsibilities
- Collaborate with a multi-disciplinary team of architects, artists, designers, engineers, and testers to design, deliver, maintain, and operate multiple game-based learning products;
- Drive our system architecture and promote best practices to produce high quality games, and coach less tenured engineers;
- Partner with technical and business stakeholders to influence our long-term strategy and establish the team's roadmap;
- Make data-driven decisions by leveraging industry landscape from engineering, gaming and training, as well as user feedback and telemetry data;
- Write high quality code.
A day in the life
You will work with engineering and product stakeholders closely on a day-to-day basis. You will contribute to the production of multiple games and features and collaborate with other learning products teams (e.g.: AWS SkillBuilder, AWS Labs, AWS Jam, Exam Prep). You will solve, learn, and mentor team members on web-scale challenges, distributed systems problems, and game development best practices. You will regularly review technical work with peers, stakeholders, and leadership.
About the team
AWS Game-Based Learning team members are spread across the US, Canada, and Brazil. Our mission is to build learning products that use game thinking principles. We combine learning strategies with game technologies and theories to develop appealing knowledge transfer experiences that target customer needs.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese (verbal and written)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops)
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Durante esses anos a empresa também inaugurou Centros Educacionais de Trânsito, de Treinamento Técnico, de Distribuição de Peças e de Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, além do seu próprio parque eólico no sul do país.

title: Tech Manager Developer
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for a skilled and versatile Tech Manager Developer to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll contribute to designing, building, and maintaining innovative software solutions. You will work across various functions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating with teams to design and develop features for global products that meet business and user needs.
  • Driving improvements in architecture, code quality, and overall development practices.
  • Actively engaging in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.
  • Conducting design and code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Partnering with colleagues to build and maintain tools for test development, automation, and release process improvements.
  • Advocating for user experience when collaborating with product, design, and technical teams.
  • Coaching and mentoring team members to foster a culture of continuous learning and growth.
  • Debugging, testing, and optimizing code to enhance performance and maintainability.
  • Developing and maintaining scalable, data-driven applications with a focus on quality and reliability.

What You’ll Need

  • Proven experience in software development, including server-side and backend development.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Java, C#, or similar.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) and DevOps tools like Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and database optimization (e.g., SQL Server, T-SQL).
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, XUnit) and automation tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies like Scrum or Kanban.
  • Proficiency in source control systems such as Git/GitHub.
  • Passionate about software development and continuously improving processes.
  • Motivated by building impactful solutions that reach millions of users.
  • Adaptable to dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
  • Creative thinker with a focus on collaboration and teamwork.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a collaborative, innovative team that values creativity and diversity.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies.
  • A culture that fosters professional growth, learning, and mentorship.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

title: Especialista de Marketing | Globoplay
description:
Job Description

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsibilities and assignments

Sobre a área:
Lideramos a relação do marketing com as unidades de negócios de Produtos Digitais da Globo.
Nosso trabalho envolve planejar, monitorar e garantir a execução das ações de marketing, estabelecendo o posicionamento e a proposta de valor das marcas, além de uma gestão eficiente dos recursos e resultados.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Planejamento estratégico de Marketing.
  • Desenvolver a estratégia de marketing alinhada aos objetivos de negócio e à análise de mercado, estabelecendo a proposta de valor e o posicionamento das marcas dentro de uma visão integrada de portfólio e plataforma.
  • Definir os KPIs a serem alcançados e recomendar as alocações de investimento alinhados com as áreas de expertise.
  • Acompanhar continuamente a execução das ações e monitorar os resultados para garantir a entrega eficaz das metas.

Requirements And Qualifications

Do que você precisa:

  • Superior Completo
  • Experiência em planejamento estratégico
  • Vasta experiência no mercado digital, streaming ou marketplace
  • Excelente capacidade analítica.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Inglês (necessário acompanhar continuamente pesquisas de tendências mundiais e benchmarking)
  • Especializações em Planejamento Estratégico

Additional information

Por que vir para Globo:
Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.
Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.
A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.
Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo

Seguindo o compromisso de contribuir para um ambiente seguro para nossas pessoas, informamos que ter o esquema completo vacinação contra a Covid-19 é uma condição obrigatória para o trabalho na Globo, presencial ou a distância, e que o comprovante deverá ser apresentado como pré-requisito para a contratação.

Quer saber mais sobre como é trabalhar na Globo? Vem acompanhar nosso dia a dia, desafios e conquistas nas nossas redes:
LinkedIn
Instagram
YouTube

Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo.
Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: Política de Privacidade .

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Firmware Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Firmware QA Analyst, you will take on the crucial responsibility of ensuring the quality, functionality, and reliability of our firmware products. You’ll serve as the last line of defense, protecting our customers from potential headaches and ensuring they experience only the best our technology has to offer. In this role, you will not only test and validate firmware but also champion a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. Your attention to detail and commitment to excellence will make you an advocate for firmware enhancements, driving our innovation forward. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact on the satisfaction of our customers and the success of our products.


Responsibilities
  • Building and Managing Test Environments: Design, implement, and maintain test environments to simulate real-world scenarios, ensuring thorough validation of firmware functionality and performance.
  • Developing and Automating Test Scripts: Create and maintain unit and automated test scripts to validate individual firmware modules and overall system behavior, ensuring comprehensive test coverage.
  • Documenting Testing Processes: Develop and maintain detailed documentation for test strategies, plans, cases, and methodologies, establishing clear and consistent testing guidelines across the team.
  • Integrating Testing into CI/CD Pipelines: Collaborate with the development team to embed automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline, enabling frequent and reliable testing for continuous delivery of high-quality firmware.
  • Ensuring Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with QA and development teams to identify and address testing gaps, improving processes and ensuring timely, high-quality releases.
  • Driving Firmware Quality Improvements: Act as a key stakeholder in the firmware lifecycle, advocating for quality-first approaches and ensuring the final product meets customer expectations and industry standards.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with electronics or firmware engineering.
  • Familiarity with data acquisition, processing, and logging techniques for embedded testing purposes.
  • Understanding of data analysis methods and their application in firmware testing.
  • Proficiency with development tools such as VSCode and GitHub.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting languages, including Python and MATLAB.
  • Knowledge of embedded systems, with the ability to integrate modules and customize test equipment or environments.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
  • Practical experience working with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, DAQs, multimeters, and power supplies.
Bonus Points
  • Familiarity with test implementations in a TDD or BDD environment.
  • Familiarity with C++ programming language.
  • Experience with firmware concepts, like RTOS, HAL, and other drivers.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, for CI/CD implementations.
  • Excellent analytical skills.

title: Cientista de Dados II
description:
Location: BAL - SEDE

City: São Paulo, Brasil

State: São Paulo (BR-SP)

Country: Brasil (BR)

Requisition Number: 40428

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Data Scientist. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate, test, and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people do not just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for career progression. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do, we live our values:

  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive modeling applied to industrial operations. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for constructing models to solve business problems, communicating with technical teams, and ensuring delivery aligns with business expectations. You will also work with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, create, test, and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions across the organization.
  • Provide technical support for data scientists across multiple squads.
  • Collaborate with business analysts to understand problems and implement scalable solutions.
  • Define development standards and solution approaches.
  • Design and structure reusable codebases.
  • Coordinate with MIS, Digital Specialists, and Data Engineers to deliver comprehensive analytical solutions.
  • Communicate the design, functioning, and output of analytical models/solutions.
  • Ensure timely analysis and testing for maintenance of solutions.
  • Present data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

  • Make decisions aligned with Bunge’s strategy, business needs, and financial goals, exploring new perspectives through innovation.
  • Build strong relationships, influence others, and develop talent.
  • Develop data-driven strategies aligned with company priorities and communicate effectively.
  • Proficient in data science, machine learning, programming languages like Python or R, SQL, data analysis, teamwork, and communication skills.
  • Assist in structuring problems/hypotheses and translating them into advanced analytics approaches, including machine learning and optimization.
  • Help business understand data science and optimization concepts for better cross-functional communication.

Education/Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in mathematics, analytics, and computer science, including machine learning, statistical models, and data science programming.
  • Avoid logical flaws, build resilient data pipelines in cloud environments, and prepare high-quality data.
  • Mentor associates and data scientists, and communicate effectively with stakeholders and management.
  • Model behavior as a team player and foster new ideas.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a global leader in sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s network supports over 70,000 farmers and consumers worldwide, with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, and 25,000 employees globally, operating numerous facilities and terminals.

Bunge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, or veteran status. Minorities, women, veterans, and disabled persons are encouraged to apply.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Great that you're thinking about a career with BSI!

Join a Global Industry Leader!

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team that has built nearly 120 years of excellence, growth, and continued innovation? At BSI, we pride ourselves on the highest standards and our commitment to making a lasting impact. If you are driven by success, passionate about helping clients, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you!

About the role:

As an Sales Account Manager , you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America’s product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a target-driven environment and enjoys developing long-term relationships with clients.

In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

Drive Sales Growth : As a hunter in the sales field, develop and nurture relationships with existing clients while identifying and securing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling.

Consultative Selling : Engage with key decision-makers in small to midsize organizations to present and position BSI products and services, helping them meet ISO standards.

Pipeline Development : Identify and qualify new business leads, building a continuous sales pipeline to support long-term success.

Client Relationship Management : Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.

Market Trend Identification : Stay ahead of industry trends, strategizing to capture new revenue generation opportunities.

Accurate Reporting : Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.

Travel for Success : Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

Sales Experience : At least four years of experience in sales.

Industry Knowledge : Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.

Multilingual: Fluency in English and Portuguese, Spanish is a plus.

Exceptional Communication Skills : Strong ability to negotiate, influence, and build relationships with both internal teams and external clients.

Collaboration Mindset : Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.

Tech-Savvy : Experience with CRM tools like SAP and Salesforce is an advantage.

Valid Driver's License : Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, health , vision, dental and life insurance, pension plan with company contribution , short - term and long-term disability, pregnancy and parental leave, registered savings plan, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

Our Excellence Behaviours: Client-centric, Agile, Collaborative. These three behaviours represent how we do things at BSI. They help us ensure that BSI is a great place to work and a highly successful business.

BSI is conducting face-to-face interviews where appropriate and possible. If you are invited to a face-to-face interview but feel more comfortable with conducting the interview virtually, please speak to a member of our recruitment team.

PLURAL

title: Sr. Analyst, Plant Finance (Brasília/Manaus)
description:
Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging solutions. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!
Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Primary Purpose of this Position:
The role forms part of two local manufacturing plants senior management teams and will contribute by delivering highly effective business partnership to our Operations team. In doing so this role will drive financial value in our operating costs being our future fuel for growth. All of the referenced responsibilities below relate to two manufacturing plants that this role will be responsible for supporting.
What will you be responsible for?
• Acts as a trusted business partner to the manufacturing plant leadership teams to support decision making and driving financial value in the form of EVA performance improvement
• In support of the above - monitor and tracks monthly, quarterly and YTD financial related KPI performance and conduct monthly business performance reviews with manufacturing plant management teams
• Analyse the month end financial close results and communicate results to the manufacturing plant operations teams (via standardized Ball Operational Excellence routines) and to the regional finance teams effectively, accurately and timely in standardized formats.
• Leads the local development cross functionally of the manufacturing plant spending forecasts for annual operating plan cycle (AOP) efficiently, accurately and timely in standardized formats
• Leads the local refresh cross functionally of the manufacturing plant spending forecasts for the quarterly refresh of the annual operating plan cycle (3+9, 6+6 & 9+3) efficiently, accurately and timely in standardized formats
• Leads the development of an “in month” monthly refresh of financial forecasts for the manufacturing plant (often referred to as the POV) efficiently, accurately and timely in standardized formats. This serves to drive action and understanding within the manufacturing plant senior management team, but also inform regional financial leadership of financial expectations in the near term.
• Management of local capital budgets, project control and reporting, including all local investment proposals (AFE’s)– cradle to grave oversight from AFE creation to timely asset capitalization and project closure.
• Support finance led regional, manufacturing plant based or otherwise initiatives to drive EVA performance improvement and standardization of processes.
• Support non finance teams education at the manufacturing plant to build strong finance and business acumen around the key principles of how the business run, how we make money and how they can impact EVA each and every day.

title: Senior Industrial Automation Implementation
description:
Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for reviewing and optimizing technical proposals to ensure alignment with the company’s capabilities and technical requirements, supporting the proper field installation and system integration. You will manage the implementation process, including the integration of sensors, PLCs, and frequency inverters, ensuring that the solutions are robust, scalable, and meet client demands. Additionally, you will oversee the go-live phase, validate system functionality, and provide post-implementation technical support.


Responsibilities
  • Review and adjust technical proposals developed by the Sales team, ensuring they align with the company's capabilities and the required technical specifications, thereby supporting the technical implementation and correct field installation;
  • Verify the compatibility of system integrations (sensors, PLCs, Frequency Inverters, etc.) within the client’s environment, ensuring that the solutions are robust and scalable;
  • Participate in client meetings to better understand their demands and translate these needs into viable technical solutions;
  • Manage the implementation schedule, ensuring that the stages are completed within the established deadlines and that the system functions properly;
  • Supervise the application and go-live phase of the implemented systems, validating the correct functioning of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring systems;
  • Work closely with the Data Science, Hardware, and Platform teams to develop, optimize, and implement features that add value to the solutions;
  • Provide post-implementation technical support, helping to resolve technical issues or make adjustments when necessary;
  • Collaborate with other teams in the company, such as Technical Support and Product Engineering, to ensure that the developed solutions are aligned with the company's capabilities and innovations;
  • Help identify opportunities for upsell or additional improvements in projects, based on technical understanding and customer feedback.
Requirements
  • +5 Years of Industrial Experience, preferably with a background in Industrial Automation and Project Management;
  • Familiarity with handling and programming (Ladder Logic) various PLC brands (Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, etc.);
  • Experience with SCADA, DCS, or other supervisory and control systems;
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, or OPC UA for sensor and controller integration;
  • Experience with instrumentation and sensor sizing (level, pressure, flow, humidity, etc.);
  • Ability to work with measurement and control systems for electrical and mechanical variables;
  • Willingness to travel to client plants and ability to conduct technical demonstration meetings;
  • Managing technical projects (scope, implementation schedule, technical sizing, and structural review) alongside the Sales team;
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with exceptional ability to present solutions to complex problems.
Bonus Points
  • CMVP Certification;
  • PMP Certification;
  • Experience in asset monitoring;
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.

SOBRE A WHIRLPOOL CORPORATION
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) é uma empresa líder em eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia, em constante busca por melhorar a vida em casa e inspirar gerações com nossas marcas. A empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2023, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$ 19 bilhões em vendas anuais, 59.000 colaboradores e 55 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e fabricação. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com.
A equipe da qual você fará parte
A equipe de Segurança e prevenção de perdas protege os funcionários da organização, propriedades e todos os itens de valor nas instalações de qualquer dano ou perigo evitável. Desenvolve políticas e procedimentos de segurança em conformidade com as diretrizes e padrões do governo. Conduz investigações para proteger os ativos da organização.
Resumo desta função
Dentre os principais papeis e desafios dessa posição temos a gestão do time de segurança local, o gerenciamento de projetos de segurança patrimonial, de logística, de imagem e da informação, visando as melhores práticas de proteção de ativos no mercado. Responsável também por sistemas de controle de segurança e desenvolvimento de procedimentos de segurança e prevenção. Além disso, será ponto focal em comitês de crise.
Suas responsabilidades incluirão
Segurança de Pessoas

  • Implantar procedimentos e práticas de controle de acesso de pessoal por meio de sistema eletrônico e procedimentos de forma a garantir a proteção do pessoal na triagem pré-contratação e checagem de antecedentes, quando requerido e necessário; treinamento e educação para conscientização dos funcionários; assessoria em viagens de negócios e intervenção em violência no local de trabalho;
  • Realizar a proteção executiva em caso de visita em nossas fábricas ou escritórios, seguindo as práticas e procedimentos locais alinhados ao Gerente Sênior de Segurança Regional;
Segurança física
  • Realização de avaliação de riscos locais em fábricas, oficiais e armazéns (próprios ou 3PL) proporcionando a atualização na matriz de riscos garantindo a aplicação adequada dos recursos e nas mudanças de estratégia;
  • Assegurar a padronização dos serviços de vigilantes, bem como a gestão dos provedores de segurança;
  • Controle dos serviços de segurança e gestão do orçamento local;
  • Conduzir os projetos novos ou atuais sobre monitoramento de alarmes, segurança e sistemas críticos sempre que necessário e garantir o correto funcionamento.
Prevenção de perdas
  • Conduzir a investigação interna reportando ao Gerente Sênior de Segurança Regional e dar suporte sempre que solicitado;
  • Assegurar o reporte da linha de comunicação entre os colaboradores da Whirlpool e a área de segurança para casos de reclamação ou outros.
  • Manter a rede com as autoridades de segurança locais.
Plano de Continuidade de Negócios / Gerenciamento de Crise
  • Desenvolver o Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e garantir sua atualização constante;
  • Gerenciar os treinamentos periódicos dos representantes das áreas envolvidas;
  • Identificar e fornecer os recursos necessários para colocar no plano.
Gerenciamento de equipe
  • Conduzir a avaliação dos membros da equipe, EPE, etc

  • Ensino Superior Completo
  • Sólida experiência com Gestão de Pessoas
  • Experiência com gestão de orçamento
  • Conhecimento em tecnologia de segurança
  • Conhecimento de KPI's na área de segurança
  • Ferramentas Google
  • Conhecimento SAP
  • Experiência na área de segurança, gestão de risco, proteção executiva e afins.
Habilidades e experiências desejáveis
  • Inglês intermediário ou acima
  • Espanhol Intermediário ou acima

  • Atuação em Projetos de Segurança visando crescimento da tecnologia vs mão de obra
O que oferecemos

title: Sales Ops - Analista Comercial Sr
description:
Descrição

Somos uma empresa SaaS inovadora que desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para transformar o mercado de seguros. Nosso foco está em produtos massificados, oferecendo ferramentas que simplificam processos e entregam valor aos nossos clientes. Estamos em um momento de crescimento e expansão, com aquisições recentes e a unificação de equipes comerciais no horizonte. Buscamos um Analista Comercial Sênior com perfil de Sales Ops, criativo e apaixonado por inovação, para otimizar nossas operações de vendas e impulsionar o sucesso do time.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Analista Comercial Sênior (Sales Ops), Você Será Responsável Por Trazer Eficiência e Inteligência Às Nossas Operações De Vendas Massificadas, Traduzindo Metas Em Ações Concretas e Capacitando o Time Para Alcançar Resultados. Suas Principais Responsabilidades Serão:

  • Otimizar fluxos operacionais: Mapear e aprimorar processos de vendas, desde a qualificação de leads (via formulários para trial) até a conversão, garantindo eficiência em escala;
  • Gerir dados: Analisar métricas e gerar relatórios com gráficos (via Excel ou ferramentas de CRM) para fornecer insights que orientem decisões estratégicas;
  • Implementar tecnologias: Gerenciar e otimizar o uso de ferramentas como RD Station e HubSpot, capacitando o time com as melhores soluções;
  • Promover integração: Alinhar vendas com marketing e pós-venda, especialmente durante a unificação de equipes comerciais pós-aquisição;
  • Monitorar resultados: Acompanhar KPIs, identificar gargalos e propor ações para testar novas estratégias;
  • Desenvolver estratégias: Contribuir com uma visão de alto nível para a organização de vendas, alinhada aos objetivos da Agger;
  • Prever vendas: Analisar dados históricos e tendências para prever desempenho e ajustar planos;
  • Treinar o time: Desenvolver materiais (apresentações em PowerPoint/Canva ou vídeos) e orientações para capacitar a equipe comercial;
  • Colaborar na integração de processos e equipes.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em Sales Ops ou vendas no modelo SaaS, com foco em produtos massificados;
  • Habilidade em otimizar processos de vendas e traduzir metas em ações práticas;
  • Domínio de análise de dados, com Excel avançado (geração de gráficos, tabelas dinâmicas) e capacidade de gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Familiaridade com CRMs como RD Station e/ou HubSpot, incluindo configuração e automação de fluxos;
  • Experiência em implementar e gerenciar tecnologias de vendas, com foco em eficiência operacional;
  • Perfil estratégico, com visão analítica e capacidade de prever vendas e identificar oportunidades;

description:

Buscamos um Cientista de Dados para desenvolver soluções analíticas que impulsionem a tomada de decisão estratégica. Você será responsável por conceituar e implementar modelos estatísticos, construir produtos de IA ponta a ponta no Azure DevOps e apresentar insights para a liderança sênior. Esperamos um profissional com experiência em ETL, análise exploratória de dados e modelagem preditiva, além de conhecimento em SQL, Python, R e bibliotecas como TensorFlow, Keras e PyTorch. Responsável pelas compras de insumos produtivos nacionais e importados dos itens de estoque considerados pela curva ABC, tais como: produto químico, embalagem e insumos não produtivos (máquinas e equipamentos para projetos, contratos diversos com valores agregados altos).

  3. Apresentar demandas do setor de Compras e realizar reuniões de alinhamento operacionais.

  7. Analisar relatório de MRP diário para atendimento e direcionamento das demandas de compras.
  8. Negociar as condições de compra (valor, quantidade, pagamento, transporte) junto ao fornecedor internacional.

  10. Abrir e fechar ordens de serviço.

  • Ensino fundamental completo.

  • Curso de segurança básica em Instalações Elétricas (NR 10).
  • Curso complementar de SEP (Segurança no Sistema Elétrico de Potência).
  • Curso de mecânica de refrigeração e climatização.
  • Curso de gestão e planejamento da manutenção (TPM, PCM e RCM).

Como é o dia a dia:

  • Realiza controles técnicos de manutenção que já está em funcionamento, atuando em todas as disciplinas instaladas, detalhando com propriedade os riscos e propostas de correção, com base nas normas brasileiras, projetos e técnicas de manutenção (TPM, RCM e PCM).

  • Contribui para o conforto e segurança dos nossos clientes internos e externos, executando projetos de melhorias das instalações de loja (elétrica, ar, ventilação, pci e ilum. específica), cuidando do planejamento das atividades, análise de projetos e cronogramas, acompanhamento técnico de campo durante a execução e recebimento dos serviços com qualidade, respeitando o projeto inicial, prazo, custo e às normas internas da LEROY MERLIN, do Brasil e Internacionais.
  • Implantar os contratos de manutenção preventiva obrigatórios, sendo responsável polos contratos de Civil, Elétrica, Hidráulica, Incêndio, Gerador, Ar Condicionado e equipamentos de mobilidade.
  • Contribui continuamente na capacitação e estruturação das equipes prestadoras de serviços de manutenção na loja, elevando o grau de domínio da equipe sobre o tema manutenção, consolidando uma cultura de prevenção, segurança e conforto.
  • Planeja e controla a manutenção, acompanhando o cronograma de atividades estabelecido no programa de manutenção LMB, respeitando o prazo e a qualidade nas atividades.
  • Implementa, em conjunto com as equipes de lojas e com as empresas contratadas, os procedimentos de manutenção (relatórios, TAGs e OS's de atendimento), ferramentas e instrumentos de trabalho, além da organização da oficina de manutenção e da área de utilidades, em conformidade com o padrão LEROY MERLIN.
  • Soluciona problemas de engenharia, emergenciais, crônicos ou intermitentes, (operacional ou de segurança de pessoas) e reduzir continuamente a frequência de falhas em sua região (utilizar as ferramentas RCM, TPM e PCM), liderando tecnicamente planos de ação com as equipes de lojas e empresas de manutenção, para a resolução das falhas que impactam nas vendas, na segurança de pessoal e do patrimônio.
  • Contribui para o planejamento dos investimentos anuais da LMB na área da engenharia, apoiando o Gerente de Manutenção.

title: Senior Technical Animator
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

The Walt Disney Company and Epic Games are collaborating on an all-new games and entertainment universe. In addition to being a world-class games experience, this new persistent universe will offer a multitude of opportunities for consumers to play, watch, and engage with content, characters, and stories from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, Avatar, and more. Players, gamers, and fans of all kinds will be able to create their own stories and experiences, express their fandom in a distinctly Disney way, and share content with each other in ways that they love. Come join us in creating the future of interactive entertainment. Epic Games is seeking a Senior Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to the next Epic project. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other artists to make positive changes to models, movements, and tools. The heart of this role is rigging, pipeline, and tooling.

In this role, you will

  • Rig characters, props, and vehicles
  • Set up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Work closely with modelers and animators to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets
  • Assist with pipeline tools and work with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya, Houdini, or other DCC
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • Positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver
  • Experience developing character pipelines and tools

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

At Bunge, people don't just come here to work, they come here to grow - solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.


Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:


• Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
• Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
• Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive model applied to industrial operations to join our growing team. As Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for driving the construction of models to solve business problems, communicate to the technical team, and assure the delivery matches business expectations. You will also be responsible for working with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

· Design, create, test and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization.

· Collaborate with business analyst and understand business problems to implement scalable and sustainable solutions.

· Design and structure reusable codebase

· Communicates the design, functioning and output of the analytical models/solutions developed

· Ensure timely analysis and testing for regular maintenance of solutions over time

· Communicate data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

· Proficient in data science, optimization, machine learning, Python, R, SQL, data analysis, analytical skills, teamwork, and communication skills.

· Develop business awareness of possible use cases and help them to understand the necessary concepts of data science and optimization to ensure better communication across functions.

Education/Experience

· Proficient in Python

· Strong foundations in math, analytics and computer science, knowledge of machine learning methods, statistical models, advanced data science programming

· Avoid greenhorn mistakes, avoid logical flaws in the models, revisits high-performing systems, write reusable code, builds resilient data pipelines in the cloud environment, and prepares immaculate data.

· Deep understanding of Database designs. Prior course work is a plus

· Creative & innovative thinking; demonstrating drive to solve problems.

· Act as a great team player and pitch new ideas, take responsibility to improve code quality and impact.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Analytics Manager to ourPartner Sales Operations team in São Paulo, Brazil .

Wellhub Partnerships team is looking for a Sales Operations Analytics Manager to partner with our Regional Sales Operations Leads across the Globe (Latam, US and Europe) and support commercial leaders and their teams to make more data driven decisions through excellence in business intelligence. This will be a highly collaborative global position working closely with Sales Operations, Analytics and Commercial leaders. The Sales Operations Analytics Manager will report to the Director of Sales Operations and has no direct reports. You will be responsible for scaling our analytical capabilities through dashboards and strategic models, ensuring consistency in our planning, forecasting and insights generation within the partnerships organization..

YOUR IMPACT

  • Develop analytical models to calculate OKR and variable compensation targets
  • Create scalable data visualizations to be used by the Sales Operations Leads as the basis for their analysis of results and forecasting;

  • Bachelor’s degree;

  • Passion for excellence and continuous improvement;
  • Strong execution and ability to drive work to completion;

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. For this specific role, please note that prior experience working with data analysis, data visualization and advanced English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. RAPP Dallas is looking for a Project Manager to join our award-winning Program Management team.

WHO WE ARE:

We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale.

As aglobal, next-generation precision marketing agencywe leveragedata, creativity, technology, and empathyto foster client growth.We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviors, and aspirations.

We foster an inclusive workplace that emphasizes personal well-being.

HOW WE DO IT:

At RAPP, our fearless superconnectors help tocreate value from personal brand experiences by focusing on three key areas: connected data, connected content and connected decisioning.
Our data analysts identify who that person is, our strategists understand what they want, and our award-winning technologists and creatives know how to deliver it – ensuring we’re able to activate authentic customer connections for our clients.
Part of Omnicom’s Precision Marketing Group, RAPP is comprised of 2,000+ creatives, technologists, strategists, and data and marketing scientists across 15+ global markets.

YOUR ROLE:

As Project Manager, you drive the initiation, coordination, implementation, execution, and completion of specific projects and tasks. As a well-connected collaborator, you ensure consistency with company strategy, client requirements, commitments, and project goals (on-time, on-budget, on-scope and on-quality). You know how to develop project timelines and track progress in close collaboration with cross-functional teams; track and report on progress against schedules and scope; and ensure the team adheres to process. You’re the master of the execution and process from project initiation to delivery. Ideally, you have experience managing the internal workflow for CRM and email development projects, collaborating with creative and technical teams, partnering with your account manager counterpart, and identifying any potential risks ahead of time.You’re creative, solution-oriented, organized, collaborative and have exceptional people skills.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and track simultaneous projects liaising with all departments from intake through delivery, ensuring accuracy, quality, and process adherence throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Communicate and report on project status via relevant platforms, channels, and meetings.
  • Understand scope of client request and implications. Able to translate requests into deliverables, assumptions, and timelines.
  • Develop project estimates, timelines, resource allocations for project initiation.
  • Coordinate project plan redirection as required through keen prioritization skills.
  • Mitigate risk throughout process and collaborate with cross-functional teams to solution and problem-solve as issues arise. Escalates as necessary to ensure integrity of client expectations and internal capabilities.
  • Support and grow client and partner relationships through organization, process knowledge, and client-facing communication skills.
  • Provide project metrics at project close-out for reporting and scope tracking deliverables.
  • Lead effective and efficient meetings through preparation, clear direction, and detailed meeting agenda.
  • Is a champion of the agency process and quality work.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 3-5 years Project Management experience
  • Entry-level agency experience preferred
  • Application of the practical aspects of project management, techniques and tools
  • Proven track record and experience in people collaboration
  • Proven track record in issue identification and resolution
  • Proficient in key software: Microsoft Office tools, Adobe Workfront or similar project management software
  • Technical aptitude/understanding of the principles and components of HTML development and testing
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication skills

Our Hybrid Work Model:

RAPP's current hybrid model is designed to enable in-person connections and collaboration that is core to our culture, while also supporting flexibility for all employees. As such, we have the option to work from home two days per week, if we'd like.

RAPP provides a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits plan. Benefits for this role include health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), stock options, Healthcare & Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts, vacation, sick, and personal days and positive activism days, paid parental leave and disability benefits. Somos feras em gerenciar os recursos financeiros — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha sempre o capital necessário para suas operações, além de planejar e controlar os fluxos de caixa, investimentos e financiamentos. VAGAS DESTINADAS PARA PESSOAS COM OU SEM DEFICÊNCIA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que nossa área faz aqui no Colégio Positivo? Vem ver!

Será responsável por auxiliar o professor(a) regente em atividades de ensino aprendizagem junto aos alunos, em conformidade às diretrizes e linhas educacionais, adaptando-as à realidade do ambiente escolar.

Saiba como irá contribuir com a nossa equipe:

  1. Acompanhará o trabalho docente, em consonância com o plano curricular da escola e atendendo ao avanço educacional;
  2. Auxiliará o professor quanto ao levantamento de dados relativos à realidade de sua classe;
  3. Prestará apoio ao professor quanto aos objetivos do plano curricular;
  4. Prestará apoio ao professor quanto ao desenvolvimento e execução das atividades propostas;
  5. Realizará sua ação cooperativamente no âmbito escolar;
  6. Atenderá às solicitações da Gestão Pedagógica quanto às suas ações durante o período de atividade desenvolvido no âmbito escolar;
  7. Auxiliará os alunos durante os intervalos de aulas e almoço;
  8. Atenderá aos estudantes durante o tempo de estudo (Study time);
  9. Auxiliará os professores nos processos pedagógicos.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos que você saiba:

  • Licenciatura plena em Pedagogia ou Letras Português-Inglês ou Letras Inglês;
  • Disponibilidade de horários para 40 horas semanais - vespertino - Das 12h45 às 19h;

  • Fluência escrita e falada na língua inglesa.

Será um diferencial se você apresentar:

  • Experiência na docência com o segmento Anos Iniciais;
  • Vivência com recursos tecnológicos na educação;
  • Certificado internacional de língua inglesa ou de metodologia do ensino da língua inglesa, como Cambridge English Certificates (FCE, CAE, CPE), IELTS, Michigan ECPE, CELTA, TKT, TOEFL IBT ou equivalentes, será considerado diferencial.

Atividades previstas


Apresentar e oferecer o Cartão de TODOS a potenciais clientes, explicando de forma clara os benefícios e o propósito do serviço. Atender com empatia e atenção, entendendo as necessidades de cada pessoa e mostrando como o Cartão pode melhorar sua qualidade de vida. Realizar vendas presenciais ou por telefone, seguindo as orientações e boas práticas da empresa. Cumprir metas de vendas, mantendo o foco em resultados sem abrir mão da qualidade no atendimento. Cadastrar clientes com responsabilidade e cuidado, garantindo informações corretas e um bom início da experiência com o Cartão. Participar de treinamentos e reuniões de equipe, sempre buscando aprimoramento e alinhamento com os valores da empresa. Descrição da vaga


A vaga no Cartão de TODOS busca por profissionais comprometidos com o propósito da empresa, que é levar acesso à saúde, educação e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Além disso, valoriza o impacto positivo na vida das pessoas, o atendimento humano, o respeito à diversidade, o trabalho em equipe e o compromisso com os clientes. O ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, com oportunidades de crescimento e evolução. A empresa valoriza a empatia, os resultados e os valores éticos. Se você se identifica com esses valores e busca fazer parte de uma equipe engajada e dedicada, essa vaga pode ser ideal para você.


O Cartão de TODOS nasceu com um propósito simples, mas poderoso: levar acesso à saúde, educação e bem-estar para quem mais precisa, de forma justa, acessível e sem burocracia. Acreditamos que cuidar de quem a gente ama não pode ser um privilégio — tem que ser um direito de todos.


Com uma mensalidade que cabe no bolso, oferecemos descontos reais em consultas médicas, exames, educação e até lazer. Tudo isso por meio de uma rede parceira presente em todo o Brasil, sempre com atendimento humano e respeitoso.


Mais do que um cartão de benefícios, somos uma ponte. Conectamos famílias a oportunidades que transformam vidas, porque sabemos que um simples acesso pode mudar tudo.


Somos feitos de pessoas para pessoas. E é assim que a gente quer seguir: ajudando milhões de brasileiros a viver com mais dignidade, saúde e esperança.

title: Lead Data Manager for Clinical Trials
description:
We’re over 2,700+strong across the globe. We’re scientists, strategists, creatives, and innovators. We value individual brilliance and build a strong foundation for teamwork across all our business. We love the challenge of our industry. We’re changing lives and redefining success every step of the way.

Job Description

The Lead Data Manager will be responsible for all data management activities in large, complex studies under general supervision, or working under minimal supervision on data management activities for small to medium sized projects.

Communication

  • Primary communication point for project teams and company departments with regard to clinical data management
  • Communication line for clients/vendors for all data management aspects of clinical projects and clinical data management reporting

Data Management

  • Coordination of data management activities within clinical projects related to EDC development, data collection, cleaning, reconciliation, Database Lock, development of final integrated database and generation of final Data Management deliverables.
  • Primary responsibility for clinical data management activities within clinical projects, including, but not limited to:
    • Study documents review
    • Data Management plan and other project-specific guidelines and instructions development and review
    • Co-ordinate/perform user acceptance testing
    • Development of Data Validation Plan/Edit Check Specifications
    • Data entry coordination and supervision, feedback to data entry personnel regarding quality of data entry and other data entry issues
    • Data validation, including automatic and manual data inspections, data discrepancies/deficiencies review and resolution, query generation and resolution, feedback to clinical trial teams regarding quality of data
    • Non-CRF electronic data handling (receiving, archiving, loading into study database, review and resolution of reconciliation issues, feedback to vendors regarding quality of data and other issues)
    • Database edits (paper CRF studies)
    • Manual CRF review (non-medical checks)
    • Clinical database lock
    • Coordination and supervision of processing, dispatch and archiving of CRFs/queries
  • Input into design of CRFs and other data collection forms; review Case Report Form design for accuracy and adherence to protocol
  • Development of CRF completion guidelines
  • Coding medical data with coding dictionaries and coding listings review (Lead DMs with medical/biology background, additional training required)
  • Electronic data transfer (import/export) specifications review and approval

Document Management

  • Liaison with Document Center with regard to maintenance of TMF and eTMF

Quality Control

  • Database QC checks performance and documentation
  • Shared responsibility for preparation and attendance at internal and client/third-party audits/inspections of Data Management
  • Shared responsibility for follow-up on and resolution of audit findings pertaining to Data Management

Training

  • Training of Assistant Data Managers
  • Project-specific training of investigators and clinical team in CRF completion

Corporate/Departmental Assignments

  • Investigator Meetings preparation/attendance
  • Meetings and teleconferences organized by client/vendor preparation/attendance

Qualifications

  • College or University degree or equivalent combination of training and experience that presents the required knowledge, skills and abilities
  • At least 3 yearsof experience of full scope of data management responsibilities in international EDC studies
  • At least 2 years of experience using CDM/EDC systems (MedidataRave or Oracle Inform preferable)
  • Project data management experience is a plus
  • Full working proficiency in English
  • Organizational and managerialskills

Additional Information

Advance your career in clinical research and develop new skillsets whilst growing with the organization.

description:
Join to apply for the Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais role at Cedro Mineração

A Cedro Mineração é uma empresa especializada na extração, beneficiamento e comercialização do minério de ferro, matéria-prima que sustenta a produção de diversos setores da economia nacional e mundial. Nossa atuação é pautada por investimentos significativos em tecnologia, pesquisa e desenvolvimento de produção sustentável com grande respeito ao meio ambiente para consolidar a empresa como referência do setor mineral brasileiro.

Fundada em 2018, a Cedro é, para todos os envolvidos, uma empresa cidadã cujo desenvolvimento integra a preocupação com seus colaboradores, o olhar atento para a comunidade, uma atuação ambientalmente sustentável provendo o melhor produto a nossos clientes.

Em 2018, iniciamos nossas operações na Mina do Gama, que já estava em funcionamento desde a década de 90, no município de Nova Lima. Em 2020, a Cedro Mineração adquiriu a Extrativa Mineral, antiga responsável pela operação da Mina do Gama, tornando-se assim a nova responsável pela operação.

Com o compromisso de estarmos na vanguarda da mineração, em 2020 tivemos a antiga barragem de rejeito da Mina do Gama descaracterizada pela ANM. Investimos no processo de filtragem de 100% do rejeito gerado com posterior empilhamento a seco. Além disso, promovemos o reaproveitamento de aproximadamente 85% da água utilizada no processo de produção, intensificamos a gestão ambiental, a saúde e a segurança das operações, e também investimos em várias ações sociais. Posteriormente, em 2022, iniciamos uma nova operação na cidade de Mariana.

Nossa atuação gerou, até este momento, mais de 1.000 empregos diretos, somados a outros 1.500 indiretos como transportadores do nosso produto e prestadores de serviços focados na valorização pessoal e profissional, na saúde e segurança. Investimos constantemente na capacitação do nosso time de colaboradores, que atuam nas operações de Nova Lima e Mariana.

Na Cedro Mineração, estamos dedicados a moldar um setor de mineração que contribua para um futuro sustentável e próspero enquanto preservamos o ambiente e fortalecemos a vida das pessoas ao nosso redor. Conheça nossa missão, nossa visão e valores!

Precisamos de pessoas que acreditem no futuro da mineração e que estejam prontas para fazer a diferença dentro da Cedro.

Nosso objetivo é conduzir um processo seletivo simplificado e escolher as pessoas certas, aquelas que vistam a camisa da Cedro, e incentivam aqueles que vivem nos municípios onde atuamos para se juntar a nós.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Realizar a coleta de resíduo diária no site da mina e a segregação de resíduos de acordo com a coleta seletiva;
  2. Organizar as baias de resíduos e auxiliar na realização das destinações de resíduos;
  3. Realizar a limpeza e organização de áreas;
  4. Realizar a limpeza de caixas d’água, higienização de bebedouros;
  5. Realizar o controle e limpeza de cursos d’água e sistemas de drenagem;
  6. Realizar controle de sistemas de tratamento de efluentes;
  7. Realizar inspeção de kits de mitigação e sistemas de contenção de vazamento;
  8. Instalar e realizar manutenção de placas de sinalização e pontaletes;
  9. Realizar recarga de álcool em gel e troca de água de lava olhos;

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Ensino Médio Completo.
  2. Experiência no cargo.

title: Immigration Consultant
description:
Join to apply for the Immigration Consultant role at CIBT

Join to apply for the Immigration Consultant role at CIBT

Our Immigration Consultants are responsible for helping corporations and private clients successfully complete the relevant immigration process so that they are able to live and work around the world. They develop a strong service relationship with clients upon contact to ensure that each case is handled expediently, accurately, and consistent with global standards. A key part of the role is to liaise directly with clients, understanding their situation and ensuring the appropriate solutions. Our Consultants use their commercial and professional expertise to provide prompt, high quality, tailored advice and guidance based on individual client needs. We help ensure clients obtain the relevant visas, work permits, visa extensions, settlement and passport and nationality papers in a smooth and stress-free manner.

Consultants enjoy the opportunity to regularly communicate with clients and relevant authorities by email or telephone, while also ensuring adherence to strict deadlines. The Immigration team and our customers come from different cultural and nationality backgrounds and this adds to the variety and diversity of our work. In return, CIBT will provide you with an interesting and varied role, career opportunities and the ability to contribute directly to the success of a rapidly growing business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Carrying out volume casework for assigned countries, including case initiation, case assessment, provision of advice on applicable rules and procedures, case preparation and submission, monitoring progress and follow up on completion.
  • Acts as dedicated point of contact to clients, providing highly personalized services that meet client needs. Takes ownership of client relationship and provides clients with informed advice that reflects best practices and compliance. Conducts regular review of accounts, assists with training for corporate clients
  • Works closely and seamlessly with Network Partner/Attorney, where applicable, to support client needs – within casework to coordinate strategy, hold assessment and introductory calls, review materials and case product, align on processing and case updates
  • Monitoring application deadlines and completing assigned work within the appropriate timeframes.
  • Using sound judgement in assessing client risk and escalating potential issues to senior management in a timely manner.
  • Taking care to consider alternatives and delivering appropriate decisions with minimal senior management involvement.
  • Monitoring visa expiry dates and alerting the client appropriately.
  • Ensuring that the appropriate client records are established and maintained and that key correspondence and documentation is saved into the client e-file.
  • Ensuring that all work undertaken is in scope, is billed promptly on completion, and that additional fees are agreed in advance for additional services. Ensuring that use of the corporate credit card is recorded in an accurate and timely fashion and within the associated case, where applicable. Listens intently to the client needs to ensure that these needs are met and anticipating customer needs, offering pro-active advice. Remaining updated on industry events/circumstances that may be relevant to the client.
  • Communicating regularly with clients to build a strong relationship while focusing on business needs and ensuring that client service review meetings are held regularly, with formal agendas and presentations
  • Attends client meetings, telephone & video conferences/ webinars as required.
  • Identifying, pursuing and generating new business leads, ensuring that work is profitable.
  • Using exceptional organizational skills to meet or exceed customer expectations (including where SLAs are in place). Responding to email and telephone enquiries in a timely manner and ensuring that advice is comprehensive and accurate, managing expectations where needed and escalating issues promptly and appropriately.
  • Utilizing resources and researching complex cases/scenarios.
  • Recommending improvements in work procedures, policies or systems in area of assigned responsibility.
  • Ensuring the client receives appropriate news updates and alerts.
  • Personal involvement with seminars, webinars, internal and external networking events etc.
  • Guiding and training junior team members in identifying and assessing client risk.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, plus 3 years of experience or Associate’s degree plus 5 years of experience in related field.
  • Speak and write in English proficiently, professionally, and objectively.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by prioritizing, identifying and addressing critical tasks, while remaining flexible to changing priorities.
  • Ability to work with professionalism, honesty and integrity maintaining confidentiality at all times and to model the company values.

About CIBT:

With over 30 years of experience, CIBT is the leading global provider of travel visa, immigration, and document services for corporations and individuals. We simplify the journey to bridge people, cultures, and business, and open the world together with our 1,700+ immigration & tax experts and visa professionals located in 60+ offices in 27 countries.

As the primary service provider to 75% of Fortune 500 companies, CIBT offers a comprehensive suite of services under three primary brands: CIBTvisas , our business and travel visa services; Newland Chase , our global immigration and tax strategy and advisory services; and Blair , our document legalization services.

We are committed to building a great global company with self-starters who help carry us forward. We hire driven, dedicated people and give them the opportunity to learn and contribute to our growing organization while creating their own career path.
