Além disso, você será encarregado de avaliar os sistemas atuais e recomendar melhorias para otimizar o desempenho e a relação custo-benefício.

Além do trabalho técnico, você desempenhará um papel fundamental ao fornecer liderança e orientação sobre estratégias de adoção de nuvem em toda a organização, garantindo que as partes interessadas estejam engajadas e bem informadas. Esta é uma oportunidade empolgante para um profissional altamente motivado que busca causar um impacto significativo em um ambiente colaborativo, focado na melhoria contínua e na inovação em serviços de nuvem.

Requirements And Qualifications

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a vertically integrated digital agency pioneering the next generation of consumer-facing brands. A category leader in results-driven growth marketing, Darkroom’s success is attributed to our unique partnership model, purposefully built to launch brands to market and accelerate growth across direct-to-consumer. Our model is predicated on three major partnership structures - Growth & Scaling, Digital Platforms, and Brand & Product Launches – threaded by one cohesive, interdisciplinary team.

Taking the startup mindset to the agency space, the collective expertise of our team of entrepreneurs and senior digital marketers are deeply aware of the newest trends in e-commerce, development, and digital marketing. Our learned experience has allowed us to take clients (and internal ventures) from $0 to millions in revenue in just a few months. We work with game-changing brands: Crate & Barrel, Popchips, FEED, Olipop, & CALPAK, to name a few.

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Dark Arts service, that has been newly relaunched as the AI-powered creative direction service for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.

  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.

  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.

  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.

  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.

  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.

  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.

  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.

  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.

  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.

  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.

  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.

  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.

  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.

  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.

  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

What its like to work at Darkroom:

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Darkweek, Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, our annual “Darkweek” summer break, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.

  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: After one year with Darkroom, we deliver a robust 401k program with company match, equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. We act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we serve and the customers we support.

In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad composed of representatives from different roles and areas, recognizing that this agenda benefits from diverse perspectives and experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Are you interested in innovating to deliver a world-class level of service to Amazon’s Selling Partners?

The Amazon Marketplace Paid Services (AMPS) team aims to leverage the full potential of each Amazon Selling Partner. We provide strategic consultancy using data-driven, collaborative, and customer-focused approaches to help our Selling Partners achieve their goals. Our services cover areas such as Expansion, Portfolio Optimization, Fulfillment Strategy, Product Presentation, Promotions, Advertising Strategy, and Brand Building. We also assist in solving operational challenges.

Your goal is to support Selling Partners in growing their business and satisfaction by working backwards from their targets and developing a roadmap. You will proactively identify untapped potential, build long-term relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, and develop processes, tools, and content for this new service. The ideal candidate will influence external stakeholders, have strong analytical skills, and experience using data to drive growth in an ambiguous environment, given the early stage of the program.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of Selling Partners, develop strategies, manage timelines, expectations, and communications.
  • Produce business recommendations and insights using analytical tools to interpret customer data.
  • Leverage Amazon solutions to meet Selling Partners’ objectives.
  • Consult Selling Partners on opportunities and potential impacts.
  • Guide the execution of strategic plans, answer questions, and address operational challenges.
  • Build trust and strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • Educate Selling Partners about Amazon’s solutions and updates.
  • Present performance deep dives for monthly reviews.
  • Own specific subjects within our organization to support peers and develop processes/tools, e.g., Branding, Fulfillment, Hiring, Tools, Deals.
  • Adapt standardized processes to local needs.

Requirements include knowledge of Microsoft Office, experience prospecting and qualifying companies, fluency in English, professional or military experience, e-commerce or retail background, and a proven track record of exceeding sales goals.

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024, we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled in your field, and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions, and adapt to ongoing changes. You are a true team player who 'chips in' when needed.

We are now looking for a Chief Engineer who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

As the Chief Engineer, you will oversee all technical operations within our organization. You will be responsible for leading the engine department, managing projects, and ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background as a Chief Engineer, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of success in similar roles. The Chief Engineer is overall responsible for all technical installations onboard the vessel, including R&M and spare parts management, while ensuring costs are maintained at or below budget.

Other responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and managing the engine department, providing guidance, mentoring, and support to achieve project goals.
  • Overseeing the design, development, and implementation of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Managing the maintenance and repair of equipment and infrastructure, optimizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.
  • Collaborating with other departments to support company objectives and initiatives.
  • Developing strategies to improve operational performance and reduce costs.
  • Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and promoting a safety culture within the engine department.

Your profile

Are you the Chief Engineer we’re looking for?

The right candidate has experience from shipping or fishing companies, is structured and systematic yet flexible, and has a positive, can-do attitude. You are motivated to respond in a 24/7/365 operation.

Qualifications:

  • Engineer Officer Class 1, CoC M1
  • Medical Certificate
  • Safety Course for officers
  • At least 5 years of experience as a Chief Engineer
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Proficient in project management software and tools
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills

Location:

Vessel/Antarctica

Travel and rotation

Rotations are approximately 8 weeks on and off, with crew changes in Montevideo, Punta Arenas, and Puerto Williams. Deviations may occur due to operational needs.

Application and contact information

If this sounds like an exciting opportunity, please apply via the provided link. We will contact candidates on an ongoing basis. Send your application letter and CV in English or Norwegian to .

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for aquaculture, animal feed, and human health supplements. Our value chain includes vessels and sustainable krill harvesting in Antarctica, logistics in Montevideo, and global customers.

Our fleet includes four vessels, with operations year-round, except for maintenance in October. Offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with a logistics base in Montevideo. We are about 500 employees worldwide, with a diverse international team.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for aquaculture, enhancing growth and health. QRILL Pet benefits pet health with omega-3s proven to support various organs and functions.

Why join us?

Expect hard work, fun, and challenges. We support initiative and responsibility, aiming to be industry leaders and continually improve.

title: GESTOR DE NEGOCIOS I
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Relacionamento comercial com a carteira de produtores de menor tamanho (hectares) na região;
  2. Originação (compra) de Soja e Milho para cumprir o programa de exportação e esmagamento (portos e fabricas);
  3. Executar atividades relacionadas aos controles diários da filial;
  4. Acompanhar o Mercado Agrícola via conexão com a Mesa Trading da Regional e Corretores;
  5. Financiamento ao produtor (Custeio de Safra): análise e defesa do crédito (Web Data Base), acompanhamento para constituição das garantias (penhor/hipoteca);

Qualificações

  1. Superior completo em Agronomia ou áreas afins;
  2. Vivência na comercialização de grãos e operações de Barter;
  3. Experiência com softwares de gestão comercial - CRM;

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Test Engineer for Electronics, you will be deeply involved in the electrical testing of hardware components and systems. Your expertise will be essential in executing a variety of electrical tests, from component-level analysis to system-wide functionality checks, ensuring all electronic products meet technical specifications and performance criteria.


Responsibilities
  • Design and conduct electrical tests such as signal integrity, power loading, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers.
  • Implement embedded firmware for microcontrollers to simulate operational conditions for electronic testing.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot circuitry issues using multimeters, logic analyzers, and in-circuit emulators.
  • Collaborate with design engineers to refine PCB layouts and circuit designs based on test findings.
  • Document all test results and develop reports that outline findings, conclusions, and recommendations for improvements.
  • Stay current with advancements in electronic testing equipment and techniques.
  • Adhere to and enforce compliance with electronic safety standards and regulations.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on electronic hardware testing and debugging.
  • Strong proficiency with electronic test equipment and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design and testing, including familiarity with EDA tools like KiCad or Altium Designer.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuitry, as well as experience with power electronics.
  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and datasheets.
Bonus Points
  • Experience with RF testing and wireless communications standards.
  • Involvement in open-source hardware projects or community electronics groups.
  • Fluent in English.

description:
Job Description

Estamos à procura de um Cloud Architect talentoso para integrar nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica. Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções em nuvem escaláveis, seguras e confiáveis, que atendam às diversas necessidades de nossos clientes. Como Cloud Architect, você colaborará de perto com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo desenvolvedores de software, engenheiros de sistemas e gerentes de produto, para definir estratégias, políticas e melhores práticas relacionadas à nuvem.

Sua compreensão aprofundada de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem permitirá que você gerencie as complexidades envolvidas na criação e manutenção de ambientes na nuvem. Além disso, você será encarregado de avaliar os sistemas atuais e recomendar melhorias para otimizar o desempenho e a relação custo-benefício.

Além do trabalho técnico, você desempenhará um papel fundamental ao fornecer liderança e orientação sobre estratégias de adoção de nuvem em toda a organização, garantindo que as partes interessadas estejam engajadas e bem informadas. O candidato ideal deve possuir fortes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas, juntamente com uma paixão por aproveitar tecnologias de nuvem para gerar resultados empresariais.

Esta é uma oportunidade empolgante para um profissional altamente motivado que busca causar um impacto significativo em um ambiente colaborativo, focado na melhoria contínua e na inovação em serviços de nuvem.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de cloud architecture que estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de negócios;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento para criar sistemas escaláveis, altamente disponíveis e tolerantes a falhas na nuvem;
  • Avaliar e recomendar serviços e tecnologias de nuvem com base nas necessidades do cliente, desempenho e considerações orçamentárias;
  • Garantir a segurança e a conformidade das soluções em nuvem, implementando as melhores práticas e padrões da indústria;
  • Solucionar problemas relacionados à nuvem e fornecer suporte para garantir desempenho otimizado;
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de gerenciamento e monitoramento de nuvem para proporcionar visibilidade e controle dos recursos em nuvem;
  • Criar documentação detalhada que abranja o design da arquitetura, políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de suporte.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Experiência comprovada como Cloud Architect ou em um papel similar, projetando e gerenciando soluções em nuvem;
  • Sólido conhecimento de plataformas de nuvem como Azure e AWS;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de conteinerização, como Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de segurança em nuvem e melhores práticas;
  • Capacidade de analisar cargas de trabalho do sistema e realizar o planejamento de capacidade para recursos em nuvem;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para transmitir conceitos técnicos complexos a partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Certificações em nuvem (por exemplo, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Certified) são preferenciais;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente.
